apks.help: No APK is published. You build it on a PC with the repository's build kit, from your own PC copy of GTA: Vice City.

steps.text: Download the repository and run BUILD_AND_INSTALL.bat (or BUILD_AND_INSTALL.sh). Select your PC GTA Vice City folder (with data, models and anim) when asked. The wizard builds the APK, installs it and copies the game files.
Open Vice City VR from Library > Unknown Sources. To update later, run UPDATE.bat.

notes: The payload's latest_version is null, but the schema needs a string, so checkedAgainst.version is empty and build-catalog will report drift. The wizard downloads JDK 21, the Android SDK tools and the reVC source. The payload says to launch once before copying and to check models/gta3.img and TEXT/american.gxt in files/gamedata/; the wizard does the copy. The repository has no releases.
